card.name: Removal verbs followed by 'of'
card.fires_on: The word 'of' (or the removal verb just before it) after words meaning strip, empty, clean or relieve, where 'of' introduces what is taken away, as in 'cleaned of all meat'.

modes.label: 'of' after removal verb
modes.description: The word 'of' right after a verb or adjective of stripping, emptying or relieving, introducing what is removed.
modes.example: Skull plates with antlers attached that have been cleaned<< of>> all meat and tissue.

modes.label: The removal verb itself
modes.description: A participle of removing or cleaning that is expected to be followed by 'of' or by a thing removed.
modes.example: The earth became sh<<orn>> of all her beauty and exceedingly awful like

modes.label: Peeling or cleansing verbs in lists
modes.description: Preparation or cleansing words in recipes or health text where something is taken off or out.
modes.example: 4 carrots,<< peeled>> and cut into 1‑inch pieces
